instruction: A wide-angle candid outdoor photograph of a yoga session in a sunny, grassy park. On the left, the woman in the gray t-shirt and green pants (R1) stands on a black mat, holding a steady Warrior II yoga pose and looking to the left. On the right, the bearded man in the dark green t-shirt and gray shorts (R2) mirrors her on his own black mat, maintaining the same Warrior II pose while looking left. The pair practice their outdoor yoga routine side-by-side under bright, natural daylight that casts soft shadows across the green lawn.
